About the Health Education event

Health Education is a Teamwork event in the HOSA secondary division. Format: speech & presentation · online submission.

Ten in-depth lessons for the HOSA Health Education team event (2–6 members), following the 2026–27 guidelines: choosing a physical, mental, environmental or societal health topic, analyzing a real audience, writing measurable objectives, researching accurate content, designing a timed lesson with engaging materials and media, teaching a real audience, evaluating learning, building the 20-page Round One portfolio (65 points) and delivering the five-minute Round Two presentation (90 points). Includes objective-writing, alignment, evaluation-math and portfolio-format drills and practice scenarios.
